name: capabilities
title: List gateway capabilities
description: List the media workflows, stable aliases (image, video, music, sfx, ...) and operations (speech) this gateway can run. Pass `target` for one entry's typed inputs, outputs and expected run time. Pass `query` to filter.

name: run
title: Run a workflow or media operation
description: Run a workflow, stable alias or `speech`. `inputs` follow the schema from `capabilities` with `target`. Fast work returns the result. Slow work (video, long music) returns a `job_id` after `wait_seconds`; call `job` to continue. Media comes back as signed URLs. Image and video inputs take a data URI or an asset id from an earlier result.

name: job
title: Poll, wait for or cancel a job
description: Get the status of a `job_id` from `run`, optionally waiting; returns the result when done. `cancel` stops it.

name: rename_app
title: Rename one of your apps
description: Give one of the signed-in person's own apps a new name. Only the name changes: its keys and access stay.

name: rename_key
title: Rename one of your keys
description: Give an active key of one of the signed-in person's own apps a new name. Only the label changes: the key still works and no new key is made.

name: stt_measurement
title: Long-audio operator settings and measurement
description: Owner only (MCP OAuth). Configure saved cutting settings independently, or fetch public human-transcribed samples and measure through the gateway. Start returns a durable job id; status reports progress, deletions by piece length, seam excess versus noise and a recommendation. Cancel stops work. Apply is an explicit separate action; configure/apply require the current registry revision from options. Public hosting does not establish reuse rights. Review the selected samples' audio and transcript rights; not-stated means the source states no reuse permission.

name: requests
title: Read or delete your request history
description: List, read or delete your own request history. Actions: list, get, delete, delete_all.

name: retention
title: Read or set your request history setting
description: Read your request history setting, or set it when this connection has privacy permission. Actions: mine_get, mine_set.
